versions.content: The V2xBtp module transmits BTP packets to a peer BTP entity using the V2xGn_Transmit() API provided by the V2xGn module. The parameters for V2xGn_Transmit() shall be set according to [13] chapter 8.2. The parameters are provided to the V2xBtp module by the V2xFac module with a call to V2xBtp_Transmit().
